tables.name: Work_Items
tables.description: Core jobs/work orders tracking facility maintenance requests

fields.name: job_reference
fields.description: Auto-generated unique job reference (e.g., WO-recABC123)

fields.name: current_state
fields.description: Current state in the work order lifecycle

fields.name: state_started_at
fields.description: When the current state began (used for SLA calculations)

fields.name: state_history
fields.description: JSON array of all state transitions with timestamps, actors, and reasons

fields.name: state_locked
fields.description: Prevents concurrent state modifications (mutex lock)

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: Property/building where the issue is located

fields.name: reporter_phone
fields.description: WhatsApp phone number of the person who reported the issue

fields.name: reporter_contact_id
fields.description: Link to the contact record for the reporter

fields.name: issue_description
fields.description: Original issue description from the reporter (unmodified)

fields.name: llm_extracted_data
fields.description: Structured JSON data extracted by Claude API intake triage

fields.name: discipline_required
fields.description: Trade discipline required to complete the work

fields.name: urgency
fields.description: Urgency level affecting SLA timers and escalation speed

fields.name: sla_target_hours
fields.description: Auto-calculated SLA target in hours based on urgency

fields.name: sla_breached
fields.description: Whether the SLA has been breached

fields.name: assigned_contractor_id
fields.description: External contractor assigned to this work item

fields.name: assigned_team_member_id
fields.description: Internal team member assigned to this work item

fields.name: photos
fields.description: Photos of the issue, uploaded via WhatsApp

fields.name: quoted_amount
fields.description: Accepted quote amount (NZD)

fields.name: final_cost
fields.description: Final invoiced cost (NZD)

fields.name: xero_invoice_id
fields.description: Xero invoice UUID for cross-reference

fields.name: xero_invoice_number
fields.description: Human-readable Xero invoice number

fields.name: xero_payment_status
fields.description: Payment lifecycle state synced from Xero

fields.name: escalation_level
fields.description: Current escalation level (0=none, 1-4=escalated)

fields.name: next_escalation_at
fields.description: When the next auto-escalation will trigger

fields.name: resolution_notes
fields.description: Notes on how the issue was resolved

fields.name: tenant_satisfaction
fields.description: Post-resolution tenant satisfaction rating

fields.name: interaction_log
fields.description: All WhatsApp interactions related to this work item

fields.name: Created
fields.description: Record creation timestamp

fields.name: Last_Modified
fields.description: Last modification timestamp

fields.name: time_to_resolve_hours
fields.description: Hours from creation to closure

views.name: SLA Breaches
views.description: Work orders that have exceeded their SLA target

fields.name: site_name
fields.description: Human-readable property name

fields.name: site_code
fields.description: Short unique identifier (e.g., WLG-01, AKL-KROAD-5)

fields.name: total_units
fields.description: Number of units/tenancies at this site

fields.name: xero_contact_id
fields.description: Xero contact UUID for the property owner

fields.name: work_items
fields.description: All work orders for this site

fields.name: contacts
fields.description: All contacts (tenants) at this site

fields.name: active_work_items_count
fields.description: Count of non-closed work items (inverted — subtract from total)

fields.name: access_instructions
fields.description: How to access the property (key safe, entry codes, etc.)

fields.name: key_safe_code
fields.description: SENSITIVE: Key safe code. Restrict field-level permissions.

tables.name: Contacts
tables.description: Tenants and other contacts who interact via WhatsApp

fields.name: whatsapp_phone
fields.description: Primary WhatsApp number in E.164 format

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: Property this contact is associated with

fields.name: unit_number
fields.description: Unit/flat number within the site

fields.name: conversation_state
fields.description: Current conversation state for this contact

fields.name: active_work_item_id
fields.description: The work item currently being discussed in conversation

fields.name: last_message_at
fields.description: Timestamp of last WhatsApp interaction

fields.name: disciplines
fields.description: Trade disciplines this contractor can service

fields.name: emergency_available
fields.description: Available for out-of-hours emergency callouts

fields.name: insurance_expiry
fields.description: Public liability insurance expiry

fields.name: escalation_tier
fields.description: Escalation tier: 1=first responder, 2=manager, 3=senior, 4=director

fields.name: is_on_call
fields.description: Currently on call for emergency escalations

tables.name: Interaction_Log
tables.description: Complete audit trail of all WhatsApp interactions

fields.name: message_content
fields.description: Raw message content

fields.name: whatsapp_message_id
fields.description: 360dialog/WhatsApp message ID for dedup and status tracking

fields.name: llm_classification
fields.description: JSON classification result from Claude API

fields.name: make_execution_id
fields.description: Make.com execution ID for debugging

fields.name: delivery_status
fields.description: WhatsApp delivery status for outbound messages

fields.name: error_details
fields.description: Error info if message processing or delivery failed

fields.name: processing_time_ms
fields.description: End-to-end processing time in milliseconds

views.name: Low Confidence Classifications
views.description: Review these for prompt improvement opportunities

tables.name: Escalation_Log
tables.description: Audit trail of all escalation events

tables.name: Error_Log
tables.description: System errors for monitoring and debugging

fields.name: error_payload
fields.description: Sanitized payload (no PII) for debugging

fields.name: related_contact_phone
fields.description: Phone number involved (for correlation, not PII storage)

tables.name: WhatsApp_Templates
tables.description: Registry of approved WhatsApp Business message templates

fields.name: parameters_json
fields.description: JSON array of parameter definitions with types and examples

fields.name: dialog_template_id
fields.description: 360dialog template ID once submitted

tables.name: Schema_Migrations
tables.description: Tracks schema changes applied to this base (migration log)

fields.name: migration_id
fields.description: Migration identifier (e.g., 001_initial_schema)

fields.name: version
fields.description: Schema version after this migration (semver)

fields.name: changes_json
fields.description: JSON describing what changed (tables added/modified, fields added/modified)

fields.name: rollback_instructions
fields.description: Steps to reverse this migration

relationships.description: Work item belongs to one site
Work item reported by one contact
Work item assigned to one contractor
Work item assigned to one team member
Work item has many interaction log entries
Site managed by one team member
Escalation belongs to one work item

constraints.archival_policy: Records in CLOSED state older than 180 days are exported to JSON backup and can be deleted
